description: NaAlO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Al atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Al₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
